title: Publish reusable score processor deployment assets
description: Purpose: make the score processor deployable by external infrastructure owners without embedding downstream account, pipeline, or environment details in Plexus. Definition of Done: Plexus packages a public-safe isolated score-processor Dockerfile and handler as a stable package resource, exposes reusable infrastructure constructs, and documents the immutable source-revision inputs needed by downstream release pipelines. Downstream integrations build, validate, scan, publish, and deploy their own image digest; Plexus does not operate a separate mutable artifact pipeline for them.

comments.author: derek.norrbom
comments.text: The deployment model has changed: Plexus packages the isolated score-processor Dockerfile and handler as a package resource; each downstream integration release builds, smoke-tests, scans, publishes, and deploys its own digest from one immutable Plexus revision. Do not revive an independent Plexus artifact pipeline or mutable image pointer. The epic/story scope should be reconciled to package-resource distribution and pinned downstream builds.
